entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: Information element that carries UE policy sections when certain conditions are met during registration procedures.

entities.name: UE has stored UE policy sections for PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE has one or more stored UE policy sections identified by UPSI with PLMN ID part indicating HPLMN or selected PLMN.

entities.name: UE has stored UE policy sections for SNPN
entities.description: Condition where UE has one or more stored UE policy sections for the selected SNPN.

entities.name: IE shall be included
entities.description: Property specifying that the payload container IE must be included when the specified conditions are met.

relations.description: When UE has stored UE policy sections for PLMN, the payload container IE must be included.
When UE has stored UE policy sections for SNPN, the payload container IE must be included.
The inclusion property applies to the payload container information element.
